description: Municipalities, regions and ministries of Greece, published through data.gov.gr publishes a large family of GIS layers that the portal harvests from the geoservers of Greek municipalities, regions and ministries; the catalogue API listed 12,039 datasets named gis-* from 31 publishers on 2026-09-29 (for example the municipalities of Chania, Syros-Ermoupoli, Rethymno, Chalandri and Oraiokastro, the Region of Crete and a ministry), each offered as a WMS view plus GeoJSON, CSV, Shapefile and KML downloads served by the publisher's geoserver; titles seen include building layers (Marousi, Corfu, Piraeus, Chalandri), historic flood points (Naxos, Region of Crete, Egaleo), fire-service posts and hospitals (Region of Crete, West Lesvos). Coverage: the areas of the publishing municipalities and regions only, not the whole country; the layer count and coverage vary by publisher. Format and access: WMS views and GeoJSON, CSV, Shapefile and KML downloads served from each publisher's geoserver, free and without registration through data.gov.gr; the portal catalogue is queryable through a public CKAN API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY 4.0 on every resource of the datasets (the dataset-level licence field is empty); cost: free. Caveats: the layers are only as complete as each municipality's own GIS, each layer has a title only as its description, the downloads are served by many different geoservers that may be slow or removed, and no layer was downloaded. Simulation uses: municipal building, facility, hazard-history and infrastructure layers for local exposure and emergency-response studies, and to harvest many small GIS layers for Greek city case studies. Related catalogue records: Oikoskopio: environmental web GIS of Greece (WWF Greece) (data-oikoskopio-wwf-greece-environmental-web-gis); ELSTAT Greece 2021 Buildings Census tables down to settlement level (floors, use, construction period, frame material, roof, lifts, accessibility) (data-elstat-greece-2021-buildings-census-tables-by-settlement); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
